GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

3. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

8. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.

10. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

14. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

16. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
